title: DECISION: PinningApiKey Debug impl redacts the secret value
description: config.rs test external_pin_service_parses asserts that the Debug output of PinningApiKey does not contain the raw token string ('secret-token'). This confirms that the type's Debug implementation is redacted, preventing API keys from appearing in panic messages, log lines that format config structs, or test output. This is a security-by-design choice enforced by an automated test.
